responsibility: Implements the ISO ARRAY OF CHAR string utility layer. It owns the concrete fixed-buffer algorithms for copy/extract/delete/insert/replace/append/concat with ASCII NUL termination, the matching capacity-test predicates, lexical comparison and equality checks, forward/backward substring search, first-difference detection, and in-place capitalization, providing reusable buffer-oriented string manipulation distinct from the DynamicStrings and I/O channel subsystems.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation behind Strings.def, supplying the copy/edit/search/compare logic and NUL-termination handling for ARRAY OF CHAR buffers rather than the public procedure declarations alone.
